name: Seven-inch single record
definition: Small 7-inch vinyl disc, usually 45 rpm, carrying one or two songs; sold apart from LPs and 12-inch singles.
notes: Shop menu lists 7" vinyl singles as its own category.

name: Twelve-inch single record
definition: Vinyl single on a 12-inch disc, usually 45 or 33 1/3 rpm, with one to a few tracks and often remixes (maxi-single), for DJ and club use; sold apart from LPs.
notes: Shop menu lists 12" singles as its own category.
